A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''ensign''' served aboard an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Unidentified Imperial transport (Hargeeva)|transport]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. When the [[Transport/Legends|transport]] was attacked by [[Uskgarv's pirates]], the [[Ensign/Legends|ensign]] was knocked unconscious by [[Ketrian Altronel]] so that she could free [[Stevan Makintay]], a prisoner aboard the ship.
